name: Serum Iron
overview: Serum Iron is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include serum iron is a medical laboratory test that measures the amount of circulating iron that is bound to transferrin and freely circulate in the blood; clinicians order this laboratory test when they are concerned about iron deficiency, which can cause anemia and other problems. 65% of the iron in the body is bound up in hemoglobin molecules in red blood cells; about 4% is bound up in myoglobin molecules. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
purpose: Health professionals note that serum iron is a medical laboratory test that measures the amount of circulating iron that is bound to transferrin and freely circulate in the blood.
From a clinical perspective, clinicians order this laboratory test when they are concerned about iron deficiency, which can cause anemia and other problems.
From a clinical perspective, about 4% is bound up in myoglobin molecules.
From a clinical perspective, around 30% of the iron in the body is stored as ferritin or hemosiderin in the spleen, the bone marrow and the liver.
Health professionals note that small amounts of iron can be found in other molecules in cells throughout the body.

In routine practice, bring prior reports and medication list.
